baseline_models.focus_anchor: The coordinated alternatives in "kill Joseph or cast him into a land" converge on "your father's face will become clear for you."
baseline_models.mechanism: Death or terrestrial displacement removes Joseph from the father's relational field; emptiness then makes the father's person and regard available to the brothers. The gain is not only Joseph's absence but an exclusive reorientation of paternal attention.

activation_trace.role: Literal life-taking supplies the terminal version of removal from the paternal field.
Land as the domain of the stranger makes the nonlethal alternative an exile into social anonymity.
Emptiness supplies the intended clearing operation and turns affection into a field that can be vacated.
Face as the person himself makes the sought object the father's relational presence, not merely his gaze.
Fatherhood as begetting and nurture identifies the contested resource as formative paternal care.

changed_reading.before: Remove Joseph so that the father will favor the other brothers.
changed_reading.after: The brothers imagine paternal presence as a zero-sum space: erase or estrange Joseph, empty that space of him, and redirect the father's person and care toward themselves.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: "And after him/it you will become a righteous people" follows the removal commands as a second temporal phase.
baseline_models.mechanism: Coming-to-be, temporal succession, collective identity, and repair are grammatically sequenced after the deed. The proposal treats chronology as a partition that can isolate an irreversible act from the identity the brothers plan to occupy afterward.

activation_trace.role: Occurrence and coming-to-be supply a projected new state rather than continuity with the acting selves.
The later phase opposed to before supplies the imagined boundary between crime and rectitude.
A human collective makes the promised reform a shared group identity and not only private repentance.
Rectitude opposed to corruption names the moral state expected to supersede the corrupt act.

changed_reading.before: They expect to repent and behave well after the crime.
changed_reading.after: They schedule a collective identity reset, as though a temporal boundary could quarantine the deed and let a newly constituted righteous group begin afterward.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: "A righteous people" can carry social repair as well as individual moral goodness.
baseline_models.mechanism: The target can be activated as a rival counterpart, while emptiness removes him from the field and righteousness carries reconciliation among people. On this reading, the remaining brothers expect exclusion of one member to cure their own internal estrangement.

activation_trace.role: The enemy-or-counterpart branch supplies Joseph's role as the peer against whom the group defines itself.
Vacating the relational field supplies exclusion as the proposed cure for rivalry.
The people-group branch locates the hoped-for repair in relations among the remaining brothers.
Reconciliation that removes mutual aversion supplies a social rather than solely penitential sense of their promised righteousness.

changed_reading.before: After removing Joseph, each brother can become morally good.
changed_reading.after: The group imagines an exclusionary peace settlement: remove the rival member and the remainder will become a reconciled people.

context_deltas.mechanism: The dream's submission, the warning of stratagem, and Joseph's promised selection turn the father's face into an axis of anticipated rank. Removal can therefore be read as a preventive strike against Joseph's future recognition, not only a reaction to present affection.

activation_trace.role: Face as standing and social rank lets paternal regard carry anticipated status as well as affection.
Submission and lowering in the dream supply the feared future hierarchy that the brothers may seek to prevent.
Stratagem and contrivance explicitly connect disclosure of the dream to a brotherly countermeasure.
Selection and drawing near supply the trajectory of elevation against which removal functions preemptively.

structural_cues: 12:4 places the rank-bearing dream in private address to the father.
12:5 immediately predicts a brotherly plot if the dream is disclosed.
12:6 continues from warning to selection, teaching, and completed favor.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies dreamed submission, a plot-warning, and promised selection; I infer that the removal proposal tries to block an anticipated hierarchy from entering the father's relational field. A live alternative is that the brothers know only present favoritism and never learn the dream.

changed_reading.before: The brothers want to end an existing imbalance in paternal love.
changed_reading.after: Their proposal also looks like anticipatory suppression: remove Joseph before his signaled elevation can convert paternal preference into recognized rank.

context_deltas.mechanism: The brothers oppose Joseph's heart-held belovedness to their own mutually supporting band and diagnose the father's orientation as astray. Their projected righteous people thus becomes a self-authorizing collective that treats redistribution of paternal regard as correction.

activation_trace.role: Face as standing makes the disputed paternal orientation a distribution of recognition and rank.
The human collective supplies the political-social subject the brothers claim they can become.
Love lodged in the heart supplies the scarce paternal attachment over which the brothers compete.
A surrounding, mutually supporting band supplies their claim that collective strength merits priority.
Deviation from right direction supplies the brothers' diagnosis that the father's love requires correction.

structural_cues: 12:8 contrasts Joseph and one brother with the first-person plural band.
The same verse moves from measuring love to judging the father's direction.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies belovedness, banded solidarity, and an accusation of misdirection; I infer a claim to corrective collective rule over the father's attachments. The live alternative is ordinary jealousy expressed through boastful group strength.

changed_reading.before: Several jealous siblings want a larger share of their father's affection.
changed_reading.after: A self-bounded band claims that its numerical and protective solidarity authorizes it to correct the father's allegedly misdirected distribution of love.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later proposal operationalizes the second alternative as a chain: reject direct killing, cast Joseph into a hidden low place, and let a traveling group pick him up. Indefinite exile becomes a mediated transfer in which strangers carry away both Joseph and responsibility for his fate.

activation_trace.role: Land as stranger-domain supplies the focus alternative's endpoint in social displacement.
Negated life-taking marks the direct route that the speaker replaces with an indirect one.
Casting until the object lies thrown supplies the physical handoff from brothers to place.
A depression in which something disappears supplies concealment without requiring death.
The unlined cut well gives the concealment a bounded physical container and severed location.
Picking up a cast-off thing supplies the proxy acquisition on which the plan depends.
A traveling collective supplies the external carrier that converts concealment into permanent removal.

structural_cues: 12:10 explicitly negates the first imperative of 12:9 and elaborates the second.
The indefinite land of 12:9 becomes a specific hidden well followed by an anticipated caravan pickup.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies negation, casting, concealment, a well, pickup, and travelers; I infer that the chain outsources fate and creates moral distance. A live alternative is that the substitution is primarily mercy or risk reduction rather than responsibility management.

changed_reading.before: The second option is simple banishment somewhere away from home.
changed_reading.after: It becomes engineered proxy removal: hide Joseph as a cast-off object so an unknowing mobile group will complete the exile for them.

context_deltas.mechanism: After plotting but before acting, the brothers solicit trust, claim advice free from fraud, and promise guardianship. Ethical predicates are already instruments of access, so becoming righteous afterward may mean maintaining a credible social identity rather than undergoing inward repair.

activation_trace.role: Genuine rectitude opposed to corruption supplies the moral identity whose performance is tested by the surrounding speech.
Heart-settling security and trust supply the paternal permission the brothers must manufacture.
Purity from fraud supplies the exact ethical quality falsely claimed as cover for the plot.
Guarding and watchful care supply the protective office the brothers promise while planning its violation.

structural_cues: The trust, advice, and guarding claims occur after the plot proposal and before Joseph is taken.
All three claims use the brothers' plural voice, matching the projected collective identity in 12:9.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a post-plot sequence of trust-seeking, claimed purity, and promised guarding; I infer that virtue-language is being used as an access credential and may foreshadow reputational righteousness. A live alternative is that "righteous" still denotes sincere later repentance despite present deception.

changed_reading.before: Their later righteousness is a hoped-for moral conversion after one exceptional crime.
changed_reading.after: The context exposes an available counterfeit: they already know how to speak the roles of trustworthy adviser and guardian, so "righteous afterward" can be a managed public identity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The father anticipates grief before Joseph leaves, the brothers stage tears after his disappearance, and the father responds by restraining grief. Removal therefore fails to empty his person for them; the absent son continues to organize his affect and attention.

activation_trace.role: Emptiness supplies the brothers' premise that Joseph's absence will clear paternal attention.
Face as the father's person makes his continuing affective orientation the measure of whether the plan works.
The psyche roughened by grief supplies the father's explicitly anticipated attachment through absence.
Deliberately produced crying shows that the brothers must manage, rather than inherit, the father's post-absence affect.
Restraint of the self from anguish supplies a father still occupied by loss rather than cleared for the brothers.

structural_cues: 12:13 forecasts sorrow before the removal, while 12:16-18 narrate its managed aftermath.
The brothers' goal of a cleared paternal face is followed by a scene centered on the father's grief and restraint.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies anticipated grief, performed crying, and patient self-restraint; I infer that absence intensifies rather than vacates Joseph's hold on paternal attention. A live alternative is that the brothers seek only physical access to the father, which grief need not prevent.

changed_reading.before: Once Joseph is gone, the father's person and attention will be available to the brothers.
changed_reading.after: Joseph's absence becomes another mode of presence: grief keeps the father's affect oriented toward him, weakening the plot's zero-sum premise.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus treats "after" as a clean boundary into a new identity, but the execution scene projects a future in which Joseph will report their affair while they do not perceive. The deed is stored as transmissible news; aftermath is latency, not erasure.

activation_trace.role: Temporal succession supplies the supposedly clean post-deed phase that the later promise interrupts.
Projected coming-to-be supplies the new identity that remains exposed to a future return of the deed.
News that arrives and is conveyed supplies the future reappearance of what the brothers try to place behind them.
The affair as their condition and deed identifies the very act, not a detached theme, as future report-content.
Fine perception and awareness supply the brothers' present blind spot around the deed's future disclosure.

structural_cues: 12:15 joins completion of the well-plan to a future emphatic act of telling.
The future disclosure is paired with the brothers' lack of present awareness.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a projected after-state, the executed affair, future reporting, and present unawareness; I infer that the deed persists latently inside the promised aftermath. A live alternative is that the prediction concerns later recognition without directly negating the possibility of repentance.

changed_reading.before: After Joseph or the act is behind them, the brothers can begin again.
changed_reading.after: Their "after" is an incubation period: the deed remains reportable and is promised to return to them from the person they tried to remove.

context_deltas.mechanism: After the act, the group engineers affect, wearable evidence, blood, falsehood, self-persuasion, and description. This gives concrete mechanics to reputational rectitude: they attempt to control the father's reading of events so that their collective face can survive the crime.

activation_trace.role: Rectitude opposed to corruption supplies the identity that the post-act performance tries to preserve in appearance.
The father's person supplies the interpreting audience whose acceptance the staged account seeks.
Manufactured crying supplies an affective display designed to make the account credible.
The worn shirt supplies a portable evidentiary surface on which the account is staged.
Literal blood supplies material proof meant to substitute for the absent body and direct observation.
Falsehood opposed to truth marks the manufactured evidence as a deliberate account-management device.
The self's beautification of an act supplies an inward mechanism that makes the external performance sustainable.
Displaying a thing through attributed features supplies the verbal construction that the father rejects.

structural_cues: 12:16 begins the return scene with performed affect; 12:18 adds a shirt, blood, and a false predicate.
The father's response shifts from the offered evidence to what their selves adorned and what they describe.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staged emotion, a blood-marked shirt, explicit falsehood, self-decoration, and description; I infer a coordinated attempt to author post-crime innocence before the father. A live alternative is that these are only a one-time alibi and do not define the projected righteous identity.

changed_reading.before: After the deed, the brothers expect genuinely to become good.
changed_reading.after: Their immediate aftermath models another route: manufacture affect and evidence so the group can continue to appear upright while controlling the father's interpretation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The standing-in-place branch is form-distant from the surface noun "people," which makes this surprising; it remains anchored in "qawman" beside the emptied father's face and is sharpened by 12:8's self-enclosed band. Render it only as an "as though" substitution mechanism, not as the lexical meaning of qawm here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "Your father's face will become clear for you, and you will become a righteous qawm" places collective becoming directly after Joseph's removal.

activation_trace.role: Standing in another's place supplies the exploratory image of the group becoming Joseph's collective substitute.
Vacancy supplies the position that the brothers imagine becoming available for substitution.
The father's person supplies the relational field in which the substitution would occur.
The mutually supporting band supplies the collective body offered as a replacement for the favored one.

changed_reading.before: The brothers simply want Joseph absent so they can receive more attention.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they seek to install the band itself in Joseph's relational place, becoming a collective stand-in before the father.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: Breaking a drink's intensity is a cross-domain side branch of q-t-l, so it cannot replace the imperative's primary lethal sense; it remains anchored because 12:10 explicitly tempers killing into casting and concealment while the focus names clearing the father's face as the shared result. Render it as a mechanism-level echo of reducing Joseph's effective force, never as a nonlethal translation of "kill."
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "Kill Joseph or cast him" offers graded means toward the same clearing of paternal attention.

activation_trace.role: Tempering a drink until its intensity breaks supplies the exploratory shared mechanism of neutralizing Joseph's relational potency.
Emptiness identifies the result shared by literal killing and the less direct displacement route.
Negated literal life-taking keeps the primary sense visible while opening a graded alternative.
Casting supplies the enacted lesser route by which Joseph's force in the household is reduced without direct killing.

changed_reading.before: Killing and casting are unrelated alternatives, one lethal and one spatial.
changed_reading.after: At the level of plot mechanics, both are graded ways to break Joseph's effective intensity in the paternal field, while literal killing remains the imperative's dominant sense.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The unguarded-and-therefore-coveted branch of kh-l-w is unusual beside "the father's face"; it remains anchored in the exact clearing construction and gains local pressure from the brothers' false promise to guard Joseph. Render it as a predatory spatial analogy for paternal availability, not as a claim that the father literally lacks a guardian.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "Your father's face will become clear for you" presents paternal presence as something made available after removal.

activation_trace.role: A thing left without its keeper and thereby coveted supplies the odd image of paternal attention exposed for seizure.
Face as the father himself identifies the coveted relational presence.
The promise of guarding Joseph supplies the contextual reversal by which removing the guarded one exposes the desired paternal field.

changed_reading.before: Clearing the father's face means passively receiving attention once Joseph is absent.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the brothers imagine removal as exposing an unguarded relational resource that their band can actively seize.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The garment-that-lies-by-its-condition is a lexicographic side branch of k-dh-b, not the syntax of the verse; its validity comes from 12:18 placing an actual shirt beside false blood and from the focus's projected righteous identity. Render it as a material analogy for worn innocence, not as an alternative lexical parsing.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: "You will become a righteous people" is tested by the material persona the brothers construct immediately after the deed.

activation_trace.role: Rectitude opposed to corruption supplies the identity whose outward appearance the garment analogy carries.
The literal worn shirt supplies the material carrier of the brothers' asserted innocence.
Literal blood supplies the visual condition imposed on the garment to make it testify.
A garment that lies through its condition supplies the precise material analogy of evidence made to wear a false story.

changed_reading.before: The brothers plan to become righteous after the crime and separately improvise false evidence.
changed_reading.after: The blooded shirt becomes an exploratory material emblem of their alternative righteousness: innocence worn as a condition that falsely tells its own story.

strongest_changes: The dream, plot-warning, and promised selection revise present jealousy into possible preemption of Joseph's anticipated rank.
12:10 turns vague terrestrial casting into an outsourced disappearance chain built from concealment, pickup, and mobile strangers.
Trust, advice, guardianship, staged affect, and manufactured evidence make reputational righteousness a live competitor to sincere repentance.
Grief and promised future disclosure defeat the fantasy of a clean aftermath: absence retains the father's face, and the deed remains latent news.
summary.what_was_special: The focus sustains moral-reset and exclusionary-reconciliation baselines at once, while branch activations expose strangerhood, collective substitution, tempered intensity, coveted unguarded attention, and a garment that materially lies. These readings coexist as traced mechanisms rather than collapsing into one verdict.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent of "after him/it" can keep open whether the brothers place Joseph, the deed, or the removal phase behind them.
It remains unresolved whether projected righteousness means sincere repentance, peace among the remaining brothers, or successful public credibility.
The qawm stand-in, q-t-l tempering, and kh-l-w unguarded-resource readings are intentionally contained because their branches are form- or domain-distant.
